message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are present on incoming audio data, config values, or text inputs throughout the data acquisition path.

No detected untrusted source handling: Google ASR credentials are loaded from a config file without any integrity verification (checksums, pinned revisions, or authenticated URLs) on the remote API source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on training samples or the dataset during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads classifiers via load_classifiers() from directory paths in config.json without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before deserializing the models.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads classifiers and extracts features but contains no checks for class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; evaluation data is loaded directly from a config file without any integrity checks.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads audio directly from PyAudio stream and config file without any shape, range, or schema validation before passing to models.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs from get_final_class, predict, and feature extraction functions are used directly with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses speech/audio-based ML models and text scoring, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
